findings.governingReading: Shirou decides stopping is unnecessary because power means nothing if the blades miss.
findings.explanation: No need to stop becomes inability to stop now.

findings.highlight: This attack is nothing compared to Saber's—
findings.governingReading: Compared with Saber’s strike, these blades are easy to evade completely.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s confidence that he can dodge the blades is reduced to an unfinished comparison.
